name: M. D. Auld
bio: M. D. Auld headed M. D. Auld & Co. of Belfield, which ran a 'For Sale Cheap' advertisement in the Cow Boy in spring 1886 offering a hay press for $275.
mentions: …n to nine tons per day. Only two horses required. Press in fine order, ready for work. Price, $275.00.  M. D. Auld & Co., Belfield, Dak.
